items.title: HAX art
items.description: Art and media from the HAX project, browsed with HAX.

items.title: Android portrait
items.description: Red android-style face with glowing cyan goggles, a HAX band across the brow and a gold lightbulb on the forehead.

items.title: Today
items.description: The Future Traveler icon as it ships: a red dome helmet with HAX in white, a green goggle band with two cyan lenses, and a pale lightbulb on a short stalk above.

items.title: RPG Glitch
items.description: The rpg-character on an 80s CRT, glitching between versions of itself. Click for a new character with a costume, pet, mood and pose from the element's wardrobe. Every character gets a link and a HAX embed code.

items.title: HAX the Web sticker
items.description: Die-cut sticker: the h-a-x THE WEB wordmark in chunky black pixel letters between pixel curly braces, with a white border.

items.title: 1880s steam age
items.description: Sepia Victorian engraving-style poster: "The Grand & Marvellous HAX, Open Source Authoring Engine" with brass gears, a human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb forming Humans + Agents = Experience, above seven stone pillars labeled with the HAX pillars on a Ubiquity base.

items.title: HAX in under a minute
items.description: A one-minute doodle explainer of HAX.

items.title: Future Traveler
items.description: HAX's mascot, a red-helmeted time traveler, in every style.

items.title: Glitch double-exposure badge
items.description: Starburst badge with the traveler duplicated and glitching, several HAX visors overlapping.

items.title: Egyptian wall
items.description: The traveler drawn on a torch-lit hieroglyph wall, lit by a flashlight beam, with a second figure at lower right.

items.title: Helmet icon (checkerboard)
items.description: Orange helmet icon with HAX band, green goggles and a lightbulb on top, on a checkerboard background.

items.title: Cyberpunk traveler
items.description: A man in a red HAX hoodie and goggles holding a glowing lightbulb on a cable, in a neon rain-soaked city, sword on his back.

items.title: Green helmet portrait
items.description: Green helmet icon with a smiling human face, HAX band, goggles and lightbulb, on light gray.

items.title: Foil balloon
items.description: A silver star-shaped foil balloon printed with the helmeted traveler on a black background.

items.title: Paper-cut collage
items.description: Torn-paper collage of the traveler resting his chin on his arm, red and white paper burst behind, yellow lightbulb.

items.title: Hoodie kid, tan burst
items.description: Traveler in a red HAX hoodie with goggles and green backpack, hands on a desk, tan and orange starburst.

items.title: Classic burst
items.description: The baseline look: red helmet with HAX band, cyan goggles, green backpack with lightbulb, chin on arms, white starburst in a red circle.

items.title: Helmet icon, light gray
items.description: Orange helmet with HAX band, green goggles with cyan lenses and a lightbulb on top, on light gray.

items.title: Halloween
items.description: The traveler lies chin-on-arms on cobblestones under a full moon among twisted trees and pumpkins.

items.title: 8-bit RPG dungeon
items.description: Pixel-art traveler in a torch-lit stone dungeon with a status plate reading 'WORLD TRAVELER, HP 100/100, MP 50/100'.

items.title: Helmet icon, light gray (alt)
items.description: Orange helmet with HAX band, green goggles and a lightbulb on top, on light gray.

items.title: Pixel helmet face
items.description: Pixel-art orange helmet with HAX band, green goggles and lightbulb, a smiling human face below.

items.title: Classic burst, face hidden
items.description: Flat-vector starburst badge: helmet, goggles and backpack with the face hidden behind folded arms.

items.title: Helmet portrait, cyan goggles
items.description: Red helmet with HAX band, glowing cyan goggles and a lightbulb on top, calm human face below, on light gray.

items.title: Layered papercraft
items.description: Layered cut-paper version of the traveler with soft shadows under a white and red burst.

items.title: Toy-room 3D
items.description: A small 3D-rendered traveler in a red HAX hoodie, hands in pockets, in a sunlit playroom with books and blocks.

items.title: The ocean is rising
items.description: Engraving-style circle: the traveler surfs a giant wave above sandcastles; caption 'The ocean is rising.'

items.title: Sticker badge
items.description: Teal rounded badge showing a red helmet with HAX band, blue goggles and a gold lightbulb.

items.title: Pixel helmet, detailed
items.description: Detailed pixel-art orange helmet with HAX band, cyan goggles, lightbulb and a smiling face.

items.title: I my tummy hurts
items.description: Crayon-style drawing of the traveler looking distressed with the caption 'I MY TUMMY HURTS'.

items.title: Pixel helmet, green goggles
items.description: Pixel-art orange helmet with HAX band and dark green goggles with cyan lenses, a lightbulb on top.

items.title: 1880s steam age
items.description: The Future Traveler as an 1880s engraving: sepia helmet with ink contour lines and a serif HAX, brass goggles ringed with gear teeth, an outlined bulb.

items.title: HAX Morph
items.description: HAX decays into Headless Authoring Experience, back to HAX, then into Human, Agent, Experience. Every transition breaks down into pixel blocks and bit noise, with rpg-characters thrown into the static.

items.title: h-a-x THE WEB wordmark
items.description: The h-a-x THE WEB wordmark in black pixel letters between pixel curly braces.

items.title: 1900s modern marvel
items.description: Cream Art Nouveau poster: "HAX, a Modern Marvel of the New Century" with a human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb, a Headless Authoring Experience ribbon and seven pillars on a Ubiquity base.

items.title: HAX The Web opening titles
items.description: A 30-second neon title sequence. Credits tell the HAX story from a napkin in 2015 to hundreds of courses while red neon letters drift by, then lock into the HAX / THE / WEB mark. Play, pause, scrub, or read every credit as text.

items.title: Future Traveler across time
items.description: The Future Traveler icon drawn the way each era would have drawn it.

items.title: 1900s modern marvel
items.description: The Future Traveler in art nouveau style: a teal helmet outlined in cream with a serif HAX, gold lenses, and gold whiplash curves rising at both sides.

items.title: 1920s roaring twenties
items.description: The Future Traveler in art deco style: a black helmet lined in gold with a gold HAX, gold lenses and a gold sunburst fanning out behind him.

items.title: 1970s rainbow
items.description: The Future Traveler in 1970s style: his helmet is one warm arch inside another, brown, red, orange, yellow and cream, with amber lenses.

items.title: 1980s corporate
items.description: The Future Traveler in 1980s corporate style: his helmet is built from white horizontal stripes, with white goggles, on no background.

items.title: 1980s cyberpunk
items.description: The Future Traveler as a neon sign: a pink tube outline of the helmet and HAX, cyan goggle rings and a yellow bulb ring, each with a soft glow.

items.title: Handheld, four greens
items.description: The Future Traveler as chunky pixels in four shades of green on a light green handheld screen.

items.title: 1990s early web
items.description: The Future Traveler in 1990s early web style: a rainbow gradient helmet with a hard navy drop shadow, a playful HAX and bright blue lenses.

items.title: 1990s snapback
items.description: The Future Traveler in a 1990s snapback: the helmet as a red ball cap with panel seams and a top button the stalk grows from, HAX in white above the snapback opening and its strap of three white snaps, the green goggle band with cyan lenses, and a lit yellow bulb.

items.title: 32-bit polygons
items.description: The Future Traveler in 32-bit style: a helmet of flat-shaded red polygons, teal faceted goggles and a faceted yellow bulb.

items.title: Terminal
items.description: The Future Traveler on a terminal: green phosphor outlines, a dashed inner arc, HAX in monospace and a block cursor at the lower right.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Ubiquity
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a teal helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted teal orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Accessible
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a Beaver Blue helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted Beaver Blue orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Efficient
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a Invent Orange helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted Invent Orange orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Extensible
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a Creek Teal helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted Creek Teal orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Free and open
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a Keystone Yellow helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted Keystone Yellow orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Platform agnostic
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a Sky Blue helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted Sky Blue orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Remixable
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a Original 87 Pink helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted Original 87 Pink orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: 1960s world of tomorrow: Sustainable
items.description: The Future Traveler as a 1960s travel poster badge: a Future Lime helmet with HAX, navy goggles with cream lenses, on a cream disc with a tilted Future Lime orbit ring and an orange star.

items.title: HAX the Web
items.description: A 16-bit title screen and speed run. Race an rpg-character through the web, jumping into glowing badges that each teach one piece of HAX, then read the run report.

items.title: Logo explorations
items.description: Sheet of HAX logo sketches: the letters H, A and X stacked as black pixel blocks in several arrangements, some with THE and WEB tucked in.

items.title: 1920s roaring twenties
items.description: Black and gold Art Deco poster: "The Cat's Pajamas presents HAX, Humans + Agents = Amazing Experience" with seven gold-lined pillars on Ubiquity and the line "Humans lead. Agents help. Ideas ship."

items.title: Episode XXVI: Return of the Open Web
items.description: A space-opera opening crawl that catches people up on HAX: where it came from, the web standards it stands on, and where it is in 2026. It ends on a Join the Rebellion card. Viewers with reduced motion get a static, readable version.

items.title: rpg-character
items.description: Games and toys starring HAX's remixable pixel character.

items.title: WANTED: HAX
items.description: An old-west wanted poster for the Open Web Outlaw, starring the rpg-character in its cowboy hat. The reward is $0, because the source is already free for anyone who forks it.

items.title: HAX of the Web
items.description: A Halloween arcade title screen starring the rpg-character's zombie pirate girl (the element's zpg seed). Type cheat codes, ask Merlin, or press start to drop into a real HAXcms site and edit it.

items.title: Future Traveler badge
items.description: Circular badge: the Future Traveler in a red HAX helmet and cyan goggles peeking over his arms in front of a red and white starburst, lightbulb glowing.

items.title: 1970s rainbow
items.description: Warm 1970s poster with a rainbow arch over chunky HAX lettering, three circular badges for humans, agents and experience, and seven striped pillars on Ubiquity. Tagline: "Every era had its tools. This one's yours."

items.title: HAX by the numbers
items.description: HAX by the numbers, 2015 to 2025: six colored icons with counts, including 675, 53, 29, 44, 247, 567, 67,515 and 14.

items.title: RPG me
items.description: Make the character that is you across HAX, in a stand-alone tool at rpg.art.hax.cloud.

items.title: Helmet mark
items.description: The Future Traveler's red HAX helmet and glowing cyan goggles peeking over folded arms, on white.

items.title: 1980s corporate (Paul Rand homage)
items.description: Striped black-and-white 1980s corporate poster riffing on Paul Rand: pixel human, Future Traveler and lightbulb above striped HAX letters, with seven striped pillars on Ubiquity.

items.title: HAX history
items.description: Dense timeline of HAX history on a black background, with many small yellow lightbulb markers and labeled icons along a horizontal line.

items.title: Brand
items.description: Logos, stickers, banners and posters.

items.title: Pattern banner
items.description: Wide gray banner of hexagons scattered with small pixel icons: hats, lightning bolts, molecules and tiny characters.

items.title: h-a-x THE WEB-INAR banner
items.description: Event banner: h-a-x THE WEB-INAR in white pixel letters between pixel braces on a dark hexagon pattern.

items.title: HAX Camp poster
items.description: HAX Camp event poster with the h-a-x THE WEB wordmark over a photo of a stone university tower, followed by event details.

items.title: Contribute flyer
items.description: Dark flyer titled Contribute to HAX the Web, explaining what HAX is, common use cases, the project in action and how to contribute, with QR codes.

items.title: Video thumbnails
items.description: Video thumbnail: HAX THE WEB ADVENTURE in bold red, white and purple letters over a black and white photo, with a red starburst badge.

items.title: 1980s cyberpunk
items.description: Neon pink and cyan cyberpunk poster on a dark grid: glowing HAX, Humans + Agents = Experience in neon frames and seven neon pillars on Ubiquity.

items.title: Legend
items.description: Legend for the HAX diagrams on black: icons for developers, projects and end users, each with its role.

items.title: Posters
items.description: The HAX campus and social campaign: posters across time, console homages, the Quest and the World of Tomorrow.

items.title: 1990s early web
items.description: Early-web style poster with rainbow WordArt-like HAX, a Windows-style dialog showing Humans + Agents = Experience, a Headless Authoring Experience banner, seven pillars and a "Ubiquity 100%" progress bar.

items.title: Game Boy
items.description: Four-shade green handheld-console poster: HAX in pixel type, "Open Source, Est. 2017", humans + agents = experience sprites and seven pixel pillars on Ubiquity.

items.title: Game Boy Advance
items.description: Bright handheld-console poster in pink, blue and green pixel type with humans + agents = experience sprites and seven colored pillars on Ubiquity.

items.title: PlayStation
items.description: Pale grey 32-bit console poster: chunky 3D HAX letters in red, teal and green, a pixel explorer + the Future Traveler = a lightbulb, and seven 3D colored pillars on Ubiquity. Tagline: "Every era had its tools. This one's yours."

items.title: Hacker
items.description: Black terminal-style poster with HAX built from ASCII blocks, a hooded human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb, and glitching ASCII pillars on Ubiquity.

items.title: HAX Quest
items.description: Green Game Boy-style RPG battle: the Future Traveler casts the seven pillars as spells at THE VOID, a dark cloud saying "Nothing matters." Menu: Learn, Build, Remix, Grow, with Run and Hide crossed out. QR code to hax.psu.edu.

items.title: HAX Quest comic
items.description: "The Quest: Future Traveler vs the Void" as four Game Boy-style battle panels, ending with "Create your future!" and a QR code.

items.title: You made it to the future
items.description: Starry 8-bit poster: "STOP: NOW. You made it to the future." Humans + Agents = Amazing Experience, seven pillars on Ubiquity, "Start building." and a QR code.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: UBIQUITY
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted in all seven pillar colors. Title "UBIQUITY", tagline "The home of the future, now!", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: ACCESSIBLE
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted Beaver Blue. Title "ACCESSIBLE", tagline "Built for everyone, by everyone.", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: EFFICIENT
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted Invent Orange. Title "EFFICIENT", tagline "Fast for the people who make it and the people who use it.", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: EXTENSIBLE
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted Creek Teal. Title "EXTENSIBLE", tagline "If it's missing, anyone can build it.", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: FREE AND OPEN
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted Keystone Yellow. Title "FREE AND OPEN", tagline "Open by design: built on standards, owned by you.", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: PLATFORM AGNOSTIC
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted Sky Blue. Title "PLATFORM AGNOSTIC", tagline "Any format, any screen, any browser.", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: REMIXABLE
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted Original 87 Pink. Title "REMIXABLE", tagline "Break it down, mix it up, make it new.", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: World of Tomorrow: SUSTAINABLE
items.description: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted Future Lime. Title "SUSTAINABLE", tagline "Built to last, light on the planet.", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

items.title: Select a Pillar
items.description: NES-style "Push start, select a pillar" grid: eight-bit heads for the seven pillars, the Future Traveler in the center and THE VOID, with a QR code to hax.psu.edu.

items.title: Bulletin board
items.description: A campus bulletin board covered in the HAX posters, some peeling, under the banner "HAX: Take one. Skill up. Build the future." Pixel students reach up to read them; the Void looms on the left and a bright future city glows on the right, where the Future Traveler waits.
